title: Derived researcher-at-IIS predicate
objective: Create a derived predicate that returns each person connected through one participation resource to organization urn:logiclens:org:iis with the Russian role literal исследователь. Interpret each evidence tuple as fact(FactId, Subject, Predicate, Object): the shared participation resource is the Subject of participant, in-org and role facts; Person, IIS and the role literal are their Objects. The second argument must be the sorted FactId evidence used for participant, organization and role conditions.
acceptance: Use only the provider-neutral epoch candidate v0 files declared by the task.
Interpret epoch_data:fact/4 exactly as fact(FactId, Subject, Predicate, Object); never swap Subject and Object.

Use one shared Participation subject for all three conditions: epoch_data:fact(FParticipant, Participation, 'http://fogid.net/o/participant', iri(Person)); epoch_data:fact(FOrganization, Participation, 'http://fogid.net/o/in-org', iri('urn:logiclens:org:iis')); epoch_data:fact(FRole, Participation, 'http://fogid.net/o/role', literal('исследователь', lang('ru'))).
Do not put Person or urn:logiclens:org:iis in the Subject position of participant or in-org facts.
Return the three supporting FactId values sorted with ordinal Prolog term order.
Place at least one ordinary test(...) clause after begin_tests/use_module and before end_tests; an empty PlUnit suite is invalid.
Bind urn:logiclens:derived:researcher-at-iis to the trusted Property component.
Do not modify or activate the active epoch.
